profile.headline: Team Lead and Quantitative Software Developer
profile.summary:
Team Lead and Quantitative Software Developer with a background in financial services.


Barclays POINT is a market-leading, multi-asset portfolio analytics platform featuring state-of-the-art equity and fixed income models used worldwide by hundreds of global institutions to analyze the structure, performance, and risk of client portfolios versus the Barclays Indices. POINT includes a C# user interface, n-tier Java EE service layer of multi- threaded Core Java calculation models, and a relational SQL database.

positions.title: Vice President, POINT Middle Tier (Java) Functional Lead
Vice President, POINT Middle Tier (Java) Functional Lead
positions.description:
Lead three Agile teams plus additional project streams, primarily aligned to the Java service-oriented middle tier of the POINT system. Act as Product Owner for multiple teams, defining and prioritizing work backlog. Provide technical oversight, drive system architecture discussions, and code review significant changes. Mentor and develop Technical Leads driving each team, assisting them to manage the performance of their direct reports. Advocate for efficient development processes. Work with Agile coach and ScrumMasters to develop more effective, self-organizing teams managing projects via Scrum and Kanban principles. Interview and evaluate candidates to grow teams.

- Architect for middle tier aspect of Multiple Primaries project, which will transition client data from a shared primary database (with shared, replicated read-only slaves) to client-specific database servers with an isolated middle tier.
- Driving renewed focus on Continuous Integration framework and culture through migration of legacy version control systems (CVS, SVN) to Git and creation of repeatable automated testing. Now releasing POINT every 2-3 weeks instead of every other month.
- Overseeing development of a Grails-based, client-facing user access management web app to streamline Operations team functions and satisfy audit requirements for client self-service.
- Partnering with external consultants to migrate POINT's middle tier from Oracle WebLogic to Red Hat JBoss EAP.
- Delivered tactical solutions to system issues and performance optimizations in 2014Q4, stabilizing the platform and providing outstanding client service during heavy-load period following 2014 year-end.

positions.title: Vice President, POINT Technical Lead
positions.description:
Led a globally-distributed, cross-functional Agile (Scrum) team as part of a larger matrix organization. Provided technical oversight, coordinated project tasks, and provided status across internal and external teams. Code reviewed implementations and offered suggestions for improvements in performance, robustness and maintainability while verifying the implementation of business logic.

- Built up system knowledge base and communication with previously underperforming remote team based in Prague, Czech Republic.
- Implemented Agile (Scrum) practices within my team. Evangelized across the rest of the organization.
- Delivered strategic projects prioritized by the business, such as enhancing POINT's support of user-defined bank loan instruments so clients receive more accurate analytics.
- Personally developed client self-service conversion tool in C# to smooth the transition of user-created partitions defined in XML for the 2014 adjustments to sector classifications in the Barclays Global Family of Indices.

positions.title: Vice President, POINT Client-Facing Development Lead
positions.description:
Drove the development of all client-facing new features, enhancements, and bug fixes to POINT. Coordinated projects spanning the full technology stack across global teams through all software development life cycle phases. Oversaw monthly release cycle including targeting and assignment of development items, managing integration of code changes and build process, and reconciliation of differences found in actual client reporting jobs run for regression testing. Trained and mentored new hires and junior developers across the organization. Participated in lateral and college recruiting efforts, including resume reviews, technical interviews and selling candidates on offers.

- Delivered over 70 improvements specifically identified by global Marketing teams as critical to protect existing revenue streams and secure new client contracts, despite extremely limited development resources.
- Designed new process and source control methodology for monthly release cycle and led the transition of the development organization in Dec 2011. Delivered all 12 POINT releases in 2012 on time.
- Grew team of direct reports from 2 to 6 within first year as team lead by hiring external candidates and leveraging Barclays internal Graduate Analyst programs.
- Implemented custom work flows in JIRA issue-tracking platform to capture prioritization, implementation and testing steps of each change. Designed and documented JIRA dashboards for developers, managers and business users that are now reviewed on a daily basis.
- Traveled to a recently built out overseas development office in Prague, Czech Republic for 3 weeks to educate newly hired POINT developers.
- Guided a team of three 2012 summer analysts who delivered a proof-of-concept "POINT on the iPad" native iOS ￼￼￼app backed by RESTful Java web services integrated into POINT's service layer.

positions.title: Assistant Vice President, POINT Models
positions.description:
Lead quantitative developer of the Hybrid Performance Attribution® (HPA) model in POINT, which breaks down the outperformance of a portfolio against its benchmark into market factors and the decisions made by portfolio managers at all levels of the asset allocation process. Collaborated with business-side Marketing and Modeling teams to define requirements, clarify specifications, estimate costs, verify model changes, and prioritize projects. Evaluated and corrected numerous code and formula bugs to improve model accuracy and robustness. Fielded internal and client questions on HPA model results daily. Mentored summer analysts during internships. Interviewed experienced and campus recruiting candidates. Represented the firm at several information sessions and other recruiting events.

- Contributed to "Principles of performance attribution" chapters in The Handbook of Fixed Income Securities, Eighth Edition by Frank J. Fabozzi (2011, McGraw-Hill).
- Rewrote specification and then implemented new curve model allowing for flexible attribution of interest rate returns to curves specific to each security based on its classification.
- Designed and implemented Long-Term Attribution feature, combining parallelized data loading and model calculation with archived storage of previously run intermediate results. Maintained accuracy by detecting and recalculating stale archived data.
- Revamped reporting layer of HPA model to use generic nuggets, produced by transformations of raw output data XML, to build flexible tables and graphs for PDF and Excel reports. Developed self- validation process to verify nuggets were consistent and log discrepancies.
- Implemented a new implicit hedging methodology to improve consistency and streamline processing.

positions.title: Associate, POINT API & Core Services
positions.description:
(Lehman Brothers was acquired by Barclays in September 2008)

Improved and maintained POINT’s Portfolio service, which retrieves analytics for portfolio positions calculated from persisted transaction data. Managed multiple production and staging environments of POINT code deployed to several clusters of WebLogic application servers hosted on over 100 Linux machines. Supported and promoted continuous integration, including scheduled builds with automated unit and regression testing. Trained other team members to perform infrastructure management tasks.

- Designed and built an extensible framework for diverse variations of portfolio position calculation.
- Decreased the baseline portfolio position request time by an order of magnitude with strategic caching.
- Created position-only portfolio concept for clients importing daily positions instead of discrete
transactions.
- Developed and implemented Request Token that tracked all requests through POINT system. Wrote log parser to search across the infrastructure to display the end-to-end path of a request, identifying
performance bottlenecks and helping to debug failures.
- Guided aspects of cultural and technological integration of POINT organization into Barclays Capital
after its acquisition of Lehman Brothers.

positions.title: Summer Analyst, Technology
positions.description: Designed and implemented two-tier Enterprise Data Manager (EDM) allowing Fixed Income Distribution managers to categorize internal cost centers, segment trading clients, and manage product classification for reporting purposes. Collaborated with Fixed Income Distribution Managing Director to identify business user requirements and test EDM client.

positions.title: Intern, Information Systems
positions.description: Expanded functionality of Investments Data Hub to process loan transaction data. Investigated, developed, and documented an automated process to load schema-validated XML data files into the Data Hub.

positions.title: Intern, Information Systems
positions.description: Developed complete infrastructure for Investments Data Hub project, a live production operational data store initially serving securities transactions to Investments systems. Co-authored project requirements document and test plan, generated test cases to fulfill requirements, wrote reconciliation scripts to validate data, and collected and analyzed performance test data during quality assurance phase.
